Thank you for taking the time to share your concerns. I am very sorry to hear about the difficulties you and your mother have experienced, and I appreciate how frustrating this has been for you.
I would like to apologise for the challenges you have faced when trying to book appointments. To improve this, we have recently installed a new Voice Agent on our telephone system. This means all calls are answered immediately with no need to wait in a queue. The system will ask you a few brief questions, and your responses are sent directly into our clinical system. A member of staff will then call you back the same day with an outcome.
You can also visit our website and submit a request through the appointment link, which is another way to reach us quickly.

I am very sorry to hear that you felt the doctor you spoke with was dismissive of your concerns about your mother’s pain. That is not the experience we want for any of our patients or their families. Your feedback is important, and I would be happy to discuss the consultation in more detail so we can look into what happened and ensure your mother receives the support she needs.

If you would like to talk about this further, or if there is anything else you would like us to review, please call the surgery and ask to speak with me directly. Alternatively, you can email stamfordhill.admin@nhs.net and mark your message for my attention.
Thank you again for raising these issues. We are committed to improving our service, and your feedback helps us do that.
